visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a high-angle shot of hundreds of bright red lanterns hanging in a grid pattern under a modern glass roof, with intense sunlight filtering through, creating a warm, festive atmosphere. Numerous people in casual attire are seen walking through a temple courtyard filled with stone lion statues, ornate columns, and large stacks of paper offerings. (2) Transitions to a food stall where traditional snacks are displayed in plastic containers; a close-up shows white, fibrous Dragon's Beard Candy and round Scholar Cakes. A vendor in a pink top is busy preparing the treats, while other people wait nearby. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the textures of the powdery desserts and the metal stall surface. (3) Shows a man wearing glasses feeding a young boy a piece of cake while sitting on a wooden bench in a serene outdoor courtyard with grey pebbles on the ground. A woman with long hair is then seen expertly pulling apart and eating a fluffy white sweet. A tall glass of bubbly, dark sparkling coffee is stirred, showing foam rising to the top. (4) A young boy in a dark blue sweater walks along a stone path toward a small, tranquil garden pond surrounded by rocks and manicured greenery. Several orange and white koi fish swim in the sun-dappled water. The video ends by cutting back to the vibrant scene of red lanterns against a clear blue sky at the temple entrance.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 每年過年. (2) [Subtitle]: 重要日子. (3) [Subtitle]: 我們都會來天公廟補財庫. (4) [Subtitle]: 每次來都是滿滿的人潮. (5) [Subtitle]: 跟滿滿的金紙. (6) [Subtitle]: 過年還有平安橋可以走. (7) [Subtitle]: 拜完之後我們去旁邊. (8) [Subtitle]: 買了傳統點心. (9) [Subtitle]: 龍鬚糖跟狀元糕. (10) [Subtitle]: 買完之後立馬開箱來吃. (11) [Subtitle]: 小朋友也超愛狀元糕. (12) [Subtitle]: 吃完在隔壁買杯飲料或咖啡. (13) [Subtitle]: 還能坐著放鬆一下. (14) [Subtitle]: 我點了一杯氣泡咖啡來喝. (15) [Subtitle]: 味道非常的特別. (16) [Subtitle]: 門口進來也有小水池. (17) [Subtitle]: 很適合讓小朋友賞魚跟餵魚. (18) [Subtitle]: 有機會來台南. (19) [Subtitle]: 一定要來天公廟拜拜走走唷.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a family's Lunar New Year tradition of visiting the Tainan Tien Kung Temple to seek blessings. It showcases the temple's vibrant atmosphere with red lanterns, introduces traditional local snacks like Dragon's Beard Candy, and recommends a nearby garden cafe for a relaxing family break.
